claims.originating_goal: Prevent live/current weather requests in the primary Ecosystem Chat from falling through to the bounded reference model and returning semantically unrelated governance prose, without claiming live-weather activation.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after exact-head Site validation passes, PR #566 merges, the public surface deploys, and the same iPhone weather query no longer returns unrelated governance prose. Live-weather activation remains separately gated on an admitted live-data source and observed forecast response.
collision_boundaries: Do not create a second primary conversational runtime.
Do not introduce NON-TV/TVC credential authority.
Do not claim weather data availability or activation.
Do not change Math, VA, HIL, heartbeat, StegGate, or Master Records authority.
claims.next_task_after_release: Design and admit the live-weather data-source/evidence contract under the existing shared conversational surface, then observe a real forecast response before activation.
